title: Legislation TOC + section content
description: Array of sections (parts, sections, schedules) that make up one version of an ordinance/regulation/instrument, with the section HTML inline. Saved at output/legis/{abbr}/{cap}/{abbr}_{cap}_{lang}.content.json (currently-in-force version) or {stem}.v{vid}.content.json (historical). Sort by `internal_order` to reconstruct reading order.

path.description: HKLII URL path for this section (e.g. '/en/legis/ord/1/s3').

content.description: Inline HTML using HKLII's legislation markup (<longtitle>, <section>, <num>, <heading>, <content>, <marker>, <ref>, etc.). Hyperlinks in <a href> point to other provisions.

prov_num.description: Human-readable provision label (e.g. 'Section 1', 'Part I', 'Schedule 3'). Empty string for the long title.

pub_date.description: ISO 8601 with +08:00. When this specific provision's text was last updated.

noteuplinks.description: Cases citing this specific provision. Null when the provision has no inbound citations; array of citation objects otherwise.

internal_order.description: Position of this section within the TOC. Sort ascending to reconstruct reading order.

capversion.description: The vid this section belongs to. Matches the `id` of a legis-versions entry.
